command: for i in $(seq 1 8); do sleep 4; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); test -n "$WS" || exit 1; OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,save:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].filter(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Save thermometer").length})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'); echo "BLE_SAVE_POLL_$i=$OUT"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; raise SystemExit(0 if json.load(sys.stdin)["save"]>0 else 1)'; then break; fi; done
